summary.intent: Work through the Callisto next-work plan: start parallel lanes (SYS-RETRY fix, test debt, docs cleanup, init.rs/derive.rs refactors, SYS-NAPI), then ship releases and run a spec-drift pass against code and binary.
summary.outcome: Opened PRs #202 (SYS-RETRY fix), #203, #204, the #205/#206/#208 stack, an R3 derive.rs split, and later a spec-drift PR correcting cli, matrix, workspace, versioning and release specs. PR #201 was closed. 0.14.1 shipped with hints that #342 later removed, and the michi `ready_by_edge` adoption was dropped.

repo: Tracking and handoff plans such as NEXT-WORK.md must stay local at .claude/plans/ and be excluded via .git/info/exclude, never committed or put in a PR.
`just ci` must be judged by the log's own `exit=` line, not the background wrapper's exit code.
Test harness fakes (gh, cargo, registry) can hide real bugs. The plan requires proving fixes with the real tool or binary, such as real jq and the real callisto binary for SYS-NAPI.

The SYS-RETRY defect was that a tag on HEAD was treated as released. Selection now observes all operations for packages tagged at HEAD, while a tag on an older commit still settles without contacting providers.
`--package` on `add` and `matrix` goes through `require_qualified`, so a bare name gives E317 on every path and E103 is unreachable there. Several specs still described the old behavior.
Wire-form diagnostic names are kebab-case (`rename_all = "kebab-case"`), e.g. `catalog-spec-not-rewritten`.
pre.json lives at `<changesets dir>/pre.json` and follows `[changesets] dir`.
`version` in pre mode still refreshes and stages lockfiles and manifests. Only deletion of consumed changesets is skipped.
The macOS bash in the test environment lacks `mapfile`, so templates need portable read loops.
The intent omits `artifactSlots` when empty, so a template jq iterating `.artifactSlots[]` fails on null.
The release harness log now records read-only calls, so no-op assertions compare mutating calls only.

code.finding: `add --package` calls `require_qualified` before `ws.identity.resolve`, so bare names always give E317.
`matrix --package` uses `require_qualified(raw, "--package")`, so a bare name gives E317 and any qualified id selects the package.
`[[package-set]] match` requires an ecosystem prefix: bare is E317, colon form is E316.
Secret masking applies only to values of at least 8 characters (`MIN_SECRET_VALUE_LEN = 8`).
Lockfile refresh and staging do not check pre mode.
`build_publish_leaves` returns `ReleaseSelectionInvalid{SnapshotVersion}` (E169) for any selected package at a snapshot version.

workflow: Write the failing black-box reproduction first, then fix. For characterization or refactors, add snapshots on the unchanged code, commit them, then move code and confirm the snapshots pass unchanged.
After adding a test that passes first try, prove it can fail with a mutation and revert it.
Use native PR stacks (`gh stack`) for PRs that touch the same files.
Merge order matters for release PRs. The release PR #340 merged before #342, so 0.14.1 shipped hints that had been removed, and the hold should have been flagged earlier.
Subagent reports were applied as spec edits only where they carried command output or file evidence. Unverifiable findings were left out.
Parallel subagents sharing /tmp scratch dirs collided (one `rm -rf` wiped another's scratch). Give each agent its own directory.
The sandbox rejects some inline env, heredoc, sed and git-mentioning commands, so script files and the Edit tool were used instead.

friction: Misplaced the plan in PR #201, which the user rejected, so the PR was closed and the plan moved to a local excluded file.
Background sessions could not edit the shared checkout, so the PR status could not be recorded in .claude/plans/NEXT-WORK.md.
The sandbox blocked inline env, heredocs, macOS-incompatible sed and git-mentioning scripts, forcing workarounds.
PR bodies written via heredoc had literal backslashes before backticks and needed a fix.
CI failed on existing tests that assumed a tag on HEAD means released, and a stray blank line failed rustfmt.
0.14.1 published before it could be cancelled, with changelog entries about hints that #342 removed.
Subagents collided over shared scratch directories, and one ran commands inside the worktree.
